title: CppCon 2014: Zaika Antoun "Microsoft w/ C++ to Deliver Office Across Different Platforms, Part II"
summary: A CppCon 2014 talk by Microsoft engineers on how Office delivers a single-source C++ codebase across iOS, Android, Windows and Mac. It covers architectures, techniques and lessons from shipping cross-platform products.
why: Cited in Electron, Flutter and React Native debates as evidence that large products can share C++ core code with native views.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Microsoft have a very interesting approach with their Office suite when it comes to cross-platform development.
